  • Method Details

    • describeConsumerFilter

      public ConsumerFilter describeConsumerFilter(ConsumerFilter downstream)
      Description copied from interface: BatchInterceptor
      Describes serialized inputs needed by this interceptor and its downstream consumer. The default is unrestricted because interceptors can transform messages or require inputs that no handler accepts. Implementations may return downstream only when excluded inputs are irrelevant to their behavior and they never transform an excluded input into one the downstream filter admits. Custom inverse projections describe the input side of a transformation; this method runs after serializer/upcaster projection.
      Specified by:
      describeConsumerFilter in interface BatchInterceptor
